description: Read datapoint values for multiple channels at once via HM Script. Provide either a list of channel addresses, or filter by room or function name.

channels.description: Array of channel addresses to read

function.description: Function name — read all channels in this function group

room.description: Room name — read all channels in this room

target.description: CCU target to read from (default: active). See list_ccu_targets.

name: get_values

values.description: One entry per channel: {address, name, datapoints}

title: Get Values (Bulk)
